description: Make the synthetic research/evaluation path reproducible and honest: complete-story sim-2 generation with detector/truth isolation, explicit UNKNOWN metric domains, locked baselines/calibration, multi-seed support, and no-network local research smoke.
steps: Add CorpusConfig and the earlytrace-sim-2 story generator controls in backend/app/simulator/generator.py, scam_patterns.py, scenarios.py, and truth_by_event sidecar types; use TrustedReferenceAdapter tokens for v2 events and keep story/role/label out of detector inputs/imports.

Add guarded story splits and metrics in backend/app/evaluation/splits.py, metrics.py, run_synthetic.py, and adversarial.py as needed: 60/20/20 complete-story partitions with the declared guard, eligible/scored/unknown domains, budget_slots/selected_alerts/unfilled_slots, zero-slot/null semantics, story bootstrap, multi-seed manifests/checksums, and all required alert-budget/PR-AUC/lead-time/friction/calibration/coverage/latency/robustness metrics. Preserve the old --days v1 evaluator separately.

Create backend/app/research baselines/calibration/manifests and research/kaggle local smoke, plus a generated Python 3.12 hashed lock/constraints artifact and tracked b0.v2/motif.v2 registry manifests; fail closed on feature/data/split/lock/artifact mismatch and never import research code at API startup.
Add evaluator, split, metric, truth-isolation, research, and no-network guard tests, and update data/model/evaluation documentation with synthetic provenance and the explicit no-RMSE promotion rule.
acceptance_criteria: A fixed sim-2 configuration reproduces complete stories, labels, manifest, vectors, and checksums; every story belongs to exactly one partition and test events remain before test_end.
truth_by_event is joined only after scoring; detector modules do not import truth/role/story labels and prediction mutation cannot mutate labels.
UNKNOWN rows remain in eligible_n, never fill alert slots, and unsupported PR-AUC/Brier/ECE/calibration values are null with scored_n/unknown_n/status rather than silently filtered.

Every candidate manifest locks libraries, contracts, splits/checksums, unknown policy, hyperparameters, seed, calibration ownership, threshold rule, artifact and dependency-lock checksum; RMSE is never an optimization target.
Research smoke cannot read Kaggle/cloud credentials or make network/upload calls and does not become an API dependency.
